rv.q: White Rabbit Red Rabbit is a wildly entertaining and still very current production, wholly unique and well worth seeing.
All in all, White Rabbit Red Rabbit is a deeply moving and, at times, thrilling theatrical experiment.
White Rabbit Red Rabbit is as interesting for its history and background as it is in its own right.
This is a production not to be missed: a performance that exists only in the very moment that you watch it.
This simplicity paired with the intimate venue of the Duchess Theatre creates the perfect playful environment for this bold theatrical experience.

cn.t: Critics praise this daring theatrical experiment where unrehearsed actors perform an unseen script, calling it wonderfully mysterious and engaging, though some find the concept more compelling than the execution.

lo.inst: Draws Thursdays at 11 AM via TodayTix app only. Performances only on occasional Mondays.
